items.name: Claude usage
items.description: How much of Claude's five-hour and weekly limits you've used, and when each one resets.

history.note: Two pills across the top of the canvas instead of bars beside the chat.

items.name: Director
items.description: Makes short motion videos with wibblets, captions and sound, pins each one to the canvas as a playable film, and renders it to MP4.

items.name: Scout
items.description: Finds real people worth talking to about one market and adds them to your Discovery board, without ever contacting anyone.

items.name: Asker
items.description: Drafts short call requests, a one-page call sheet and follow-ups for customer-discovery calls; you send every message.

items.name: Debrief
items.description: Scores a customer-discovery call on the earlyvangelist ladder, quoting the person's own words as evidence.

history.note: Pins each call card once, as html, instead of a draft first.

items.name: Discovery kit
items.description: Customer discovery for founders: find people, ask for calls, score each call on a hair-on-fire ladder, and see when a market has earned a yes.

history.note: Four zones in one row, lined up as they land. Plan and Clutter are gone.
The Discovery zone fits its board.

items.name: Trim
items.description: Quietly removes old tool output your agents no longer need, so every request costs less. Shows what it saved.

history.note: Cuts only when they pay back; hover shows the working; live prices.

items.name: Apollo
items.description: Find people in Apollo by title, place and company size for free, then reveal work emails only when you say so. Shows your credit balance.

history.note: A slow reveal stops in time to hand back what it paid for; people Apollo couldn't reach stay retryable; clearer key errors.

items.name: Lead scout
items.description: Turns a note about who you want to reach into filters, finds people who fit, and adds them to your lead board. Never spends credits or contacts anyone.

items.name: Outreach asker
items.description: Writes one email, call sheet or LinkedIn note per person for the ways you chose to reach them; you send every message.

items.name: Lead finder kit
items.description: Find people to reach, pick how to reach each one, and get drafts to send. Works with Apollo (free search, credits only when you say so), web search or your own list.

history.note: All four zones stand at one height and scroll inside, so the kit stays one even row as drafts arrive.
Who to find and Leads stand at one fixed height and scroll inside, so the kit's zones line up.
Picks always go to this kit's own zones, even when another zone has the same name.
Pages no longer stack on top of each other; boards fit two cards across.
